body:
> For me it's trying to show the user that the code is readable while it's not very readable and it will just raise the FUD around it.

Ideally, I would remove webpack from the `app.js` file but didn't want to remove your `require("template/...")` instructions. I understand it's not very nice, but I think it's already better than what we have. Then if we find a loader that is replacing the `require` in place without defining those `__webpack_require__` functions, maybe it's a good compromise.

> Users really wanting to know how the example works can just have a look at the source code.

I'm convinced that's a very very small part of the users.
